title: MEPs are panicking about ‘Islamist entryism’ while the real infiltrators are the far-right and their foreign backers
lede: Various investigations and reports now point to how foreign entities are engaged in an industrialisation and weaponisation of Islamophobia across Europe and how European Muslim citizens and organisations have become collateral damage in wider geopolitical and ideological battles.

title: US Department of Labor to strip ESG from workplace pension rules
lede: Proposed ERISA amendments would remove ESG references in interests of 'neutrality', add restrictions to stewardship activities.
